about_the_game:
Get a first taste of Full Metal Sergeant 2 with this demo! Experience the intense and strategic gameplay as you train your recruits and lead them into battle.

What's in the demo:

  • Complete Training Loop: Manage your recruits' progress by improving their core stats: Strength, Shooting, Melee, Intelligence, Discipline, and Agility. Choose the best training regimen and build the ultimate squad.

  • First Mission: Test your recruits in a challenging combat scenario set in the heart of the Vietnam War. Make strategic decisions on the battlefield, gather resources, and adapt to unexpected events.

This demo offers a sneak peek into the blend of military training simulation and tactical combat that defines Full Metal Sergeant 2. Prove your leadership skills and prepare for the full campaign!

  • OS: Window 10/11 - 64bit only

short_description: The Sergeant is back. Ready to turn unqualified recruits into fearless war machines. Manage your camp and prepare your squad with tougher training and new challenges, will they be ready for a real battlefield? New skill tree, more abilities and a reworked battle system. Start you deployment now.
